krschloss.name: Karlsruhe Palace
krschloss.slogan: Thirty-two avenues, one tower, and a whole city opened like a fan.
krschloss.line: The city was planned with the palace tower at the centre and 32 streets radiating out from it, which earned Karlsruhe the nickname Fächerstadt.

krmaulbronn.name: Maulbronn Monastery
krmaulbronn.slogan: Eight centuries of Cistercian calm, down to the last water channel.
krmaulbronn.line: Founded in 1147, its Protestant seminary later taught Kepler, Hölderlin and Hermann Hesse.

krbbfriedrichsbad.name: Friedrichsbad
krbbfriedrichsbad.slogan: A Roman-Irish bath circuit that has been steaming since 1877.
krbbfriedrichsbad.line: Baden-Baden sits in the lap of the hills, and the natural and artificial beauties of the surroundings are combined effectively and charmingly.

krtrifels.name: Trifels Castle
krtrifels.slogan: A sandstone eyrie where emperors kept their crowns and a king his cell.
krtrifels.line: Richard the Lionheart was held prisoner here in 1193 and 1194 until a huge ransom was paid.

krbbcasino.name: Casino Baden-Baden
krbbcasino.slogan: Red velvet, chandeliers and a roulette wheel that ruined a novelist.
krbbcasino.line: Dostoevsky's novel The Gambler was inspired by his visit to the Kurhaus casino, designed by Weinbrenner in 1824.
